memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: The southern side began at the outskirts of Kiriath Jearim on the west, and the boundary came out at the spring of the waters of Nephtoah. The boundary went down to the foot of the hill facing the Valley of Ben Hinnom, north of the Valley of Rephaim. It continued down the Hinnom Valley along the southern slope of the Jebusite city and so to En Rogel. It then curved north, went to En Shemesh, continued to Geliloth, which faces the Pass of Adummim, and ran down to the Stone of Bohan son of Reuben - Josh 18:15-17 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
The careful tracing of Benjamin's southern boundary continues — springs, valleys, slopes, stones. Once again we notice how thoroughly God maps out the inheritance of even the smallest tribe. No corner is left vague. Every spring and hillside is accounted for, showing how completely God attends to the details of His people's provision.

Notice that the boundary runs along "the southern slope of the Jebusite city" — that is, Jerusalem, still in enemy hands at this point. The city that would one day become the centre of God's dealings with His people sits right on Benjamin's border, waiting for its future. God was quietly positioning things for what He would do generations later, even while the ground was still contested.

The precision of these boundaries reminds us that God is not careless with His people's portion. He knows exactly what He has given each of us and marks it out with care. When we feel our lives are haphazard or overlooked, we can remember the God who traced Benjamin's border spring by spring. He orders our lives with the same attention. Even the contested corners, the unfinished business on our borders, are within His long view. The God of infinite detail is working out His purposes in the fine print of our lives (Ps 139:16).

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- Do you believe God attends to the fine details of your life?
- How does God's careful mapping of Benjamin's land reassure you?
- What "contested corner" of your life might God be positioning for future good?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, thank You that You map out my life with care, down to the smallest detail. Help me to trust Your long view, even over the unfinished corners of my life. Amen.
